body:
REVIEW OF EXACT REVISION-2 BYTES — BLOCK on one V6 contradiction; V1-V5 accepted as repaired.

Verified artifact identity: 36,095 bytes, SHA-256 b69819b85fd03955505a5a836b50d2560392d00447f97b59d27b87da6f75a618. I read the complete 276-line file. The broad R3 sentence is gone; R11 now has separate order-permutation and identity-conflict cells; standing is byte-honest; D1/D2, Q5, the milestone/protocol collision, and E4 sequencing are repaired; design-stage courts now name required dispositions.

SOLE BLOCKER — R10 cannot derive its own BaselineHeuristic value.

R3.5 defines exactly three witnesses: conformance, authenticity, and scientific admission (lines 88-92). R10.2 then says the qualification is derived from the construction witness of R3.5 and from nothing else, and that no witness means AuthorityAbsent (line 161). But Court R10 requires an artifact built through RecallSegmenter to derive BaselineHeuristic (line 166). RecallSegmenter has no R3.5 witness that means baseline route; R3.3 explicitly says missing authority does not establish heuristic construction. Therefore the required fixture has only the published derivation AuthorityAbsent, while the court requires BaselineHeuristic.

The same missing coordinate leaves ProviderResolved versus Adjudicated under-specified: R3.5b says provider/adjudicator authenticity together, and Court R10 has no adjudicated fixture even though Adjudicated is one of the four closed values. A closed enum does not cure caller-selected classification when the proof-to-value function is partial or ambiguous.

Required repair: introduce or name an unforgeable construction-route proof distinct from the R3 conformance/authenticity/admission witnesses, then state the total derivation table. At minimum: a baseline-route proof minted only by the baseline constructor; conformance plus authenticated provider route -> ProviderResolved; conformance plus authenticated adjudicator route -> Adjudicated; no admitted route proof -> AuthorityAbsent. The route proof must not be a public constructor argument, and the complete-construction identity must bind it. Add the missing adjudicated positive control and a laundering mutant showing that swapping a caller-written route label cannot satisfy the court.

I am not asking to reopen V1-V5 or the scientific spine. I withhold ACK only for exact b69819b8 until V6 has a lawful derivation for every published value. No implementation, path, bead, ADR, or landing authority claimed.
